limits: Executes the actual stdlib job emitters for Actions and Woodpecker, including dollar expansion and Actions shell flags. Real owned Git establishes published unmerged permissive checker, older main ancestor, missing main and genuinely shallow main. Only the fixed official URL and HTTP metadata are redirected; no live network, CI or package installation. BAD pin must not be fetched directly, checked out or executed, and must report not-reachable/exit5. Missing/shallow main is UNKNOWN/exit5, not approval. GOOD main ancestor executes its own checker. Constructed blind anchor mistakes readable main for pin approval and fetches arbitrary missing pins, retaining missing/shallow-main UNKNOWN behavior while executing the unmerged feature sentinel. Historical pre-fix behavior is independently pinned by unit tests. This does not make PR-owned workflows tamper-proof or reject old approved main ancestors.

anchors.origin: constructed bootstrap mistaking readable main for pin approval, with an unsafe raw-pin fallback
anchors.why: Keeps full official main fetch and unknown-state refusals, but omits pin membership and fetches a missing arbitrary pin, executing the unmerged feature sentinel.
